prompt_transform.guidance: Use stable identity descriptors for face, hair, wardrobe, age range, posture, and distinctive traits.
prompt_transform.template: Subject/Character: {subject} keeps stable identity descriptors across nodes.

negative_constraints: Do not change age, hairstyle, wardrobe, or distinctive features accidentally.
Do not describe the same character with contradictory labels.
quality_checks: Stable descriptors can be reused in future prompts.
The character identity is separate from one-off action.

source_refs.label: Ideogram Character Reference
source_refs.note: Character references preserve facial features, hair, and key traits.

source_refs.label: Midjourney Character Reference
source_refs.note: Detailed text prompts still matter alongside character references.

prompt_transform.guidance: When a character reference exists, reuse identity while allowing scene, action, and emotion to change.
prompt_transform.template: Subject/Character: preserve {subject} identity; update scene and action according to this node.

negative_constraints: Do not copy the reference image composition if the node asks for a new scene.
Do not let the reference override the current action.
quality_checks: Identity is preserved separately from pose and environment.

source_refs.label: Midjourney Character Reference
source_refs.note: Character reference controls identity but text conveys scene details.

prompt_transform.guidance: Express emotion through gaze, shoulders, hands, pace, facial tension, or stillness.
prompt_transform.template: Subject/Character: {subject} shows {emotion} through visible cues tied to {action}.

negative_constraints: Do not state emotion only as an adjective.
Do not exaggerate facial expression when the style calls for restraint.
quality_checks: Emotion is visible in posture or behavior.

source_refs.label: Runway Academy Prompting Guide
source_refs.note: Visual descriptions should say what we see.

prompt_transform.guidance: For recurring characters, carry wardrobe and silhouette unless there is an explicit story transition.
prompt_transform.template: Continuity: lock {subject} wardrobe and silhouette across related nodes.

negative_constraints: Do not vary clothing colors, accessories, or silhouette without reason.
Do not treat style preference as permission to redesign the character.
quality_checks: Wardrobe remains stable across sequential outputs.

source_refs.label: Ideogram Character Reference
source_refs.note: Reusable references help build cohesive image series.

prompt_transform.guidance: Separate reusable character identity from one-off action, location, and style wording.
prompt_transform.template: Subject/Character: reusable identity for {subject} stays stable while this node changes action or scene.

negative_constraints: Do not rewrite a recurring character as a new person.
Do not let style preference alter identity traits.
quality_checks: Node action remains separate from character identity.

source_refs.label: Ideogram Character Reference
source_refs.note: Defined characters can be reused across prompts.
